Standard: Position lights meet the following: a. Forward position lights: Forward position lights consist of an Aviation Red and an Aviation Green light spaced laterally as far apart as practicable and installed forward on the air vehicle so that, with the air vehicle in the normal flying position, the red light is on the left side and the green light is on the right side. Each forward position light shows unbroken light within the dihedral angles shown on FIGURE 3. b. Rear position light: For rotary-wing air vehicles, the rear position light consists of an Aviation White light mounted as far aft as practicable. For fixed-wing air vehicle, the rear position light consists of an Aviation White light mounted as far aft as practicable on the air vehicle tail or on each wing tip. Each rear position light shows unbroken light within the dihedral angles shown on FIGURE 3. If the rear position light, when mounted as far aft as practicable, cannot show unbroken light within dihedral angle A, a solid angle or angles of obstructed visibility totaling not more than 0.04 steradians is allowable within that dihedral angle, if such solid angle is within a cone whose apex is at the rear position light and whose elements make an angle of 30 degrees with a vertical line passing through the rear position light. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Forward and rear position light installation locations are verified by examination of the light installation on the air vehicle. Test.
  (1) Ground test: Chromaticity of the position lights is verified as installed on air vehicle.
